description: Markdown vault MCP server with FTS5 + semantic search and frontmatter indexing
name: io.github.pvliesdonk/markdown-vault-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Public base URL of the deployed server, e.g. `https://mcp.example.com`. Required for OIDC. Also the fallback source of the MCP Apps domain when `app_domain` is unset.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Single shared bearer token; enables bearer auth unless `bearer_tokens_file` is set, which takes precedence.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: OIDC discovery document URL, e.g. `https://auth.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration`.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_CONFIG_URL

environmentVariables.description: OIDC client identifier registered with the provider.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: OIDC client secret registered with the provider.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Expected `aud` claim; tokens issued for another audience are rejected.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_AUDIENCE

environmentVariables.description: Scopes a caller must present, space- or comma-separated. Defaults to `openid` in oidc-proxy mode.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_REQUIRED_SCOPES

environmentVariables.description: Scopes advertised to MCP clients in protected-resource metadata, space- or comma-separated. Overrides the default `openid offline_access`; `oidc_required_scopes` is always added on top. Set this when the registered client is not permitted `offline_access`, or to have clients request extra claim scopes (e.g. `groups`) without also requiring them in every token.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_ADVERTISED_SCOPES

environmentVariables.description: Signing key for issued JWTs; used in oidc-proxy mode only. When unset, the key is derived deterministically from `oidc_client_secret`, so tokens survive a restart — but rotating that secret invalidates every issued token. Set this explicitly to decouple token validity from secret rotation. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_JWT_SIGNING_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Validate the access token instead of the id token.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_VERIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Persistent-state backend URL shared by every pvl-core subsystem that needs state. `memory://` is in-process and lost on restart; `file:///path` persists on one server; `redis://`, `dynamodb://` and `mongodb://` each need their matching extra. When unset, defaults to `file:///data/state` (the volume family Docker images mount), or to `memory://` — with a warning — on a host where that directory is not usable.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_KV_STORE_URL

environmentVariables.description: MCP Apps iframe domain, used for CSP sandboxing. Overrides the host derived from `base_url`.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_APP_DOMAIN

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names this instance exposes; every other tool is hidden from listings and cannot be invoked. Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_deny`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TOOLS_ALLOW

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names hidden from this instance (absent from listings, cannot be invoked). Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_allow`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TOOLS_DENY

environmentVariables.description: Explicit auth-mode override, accepting `remote` or `oidc-proxy` (case- and whitespace-insensitive). When unset the mode is auto-detected from which auth variables are set; the override exists because having all four OIDC variables set is ambiguous between those two modes. Other values are ignored with a warning.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_AUTH_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Path to a TOML file mapping bearer tokens to subjects; overrides the single-token `bearer_token` mode.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BEARER_TOKENS_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Subject assigned to the single-token bearer mode; ignored when `bearer_tokens_file` is set, since mapped mode carries per-token subjects.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BEARER_DEFAULT_SUBJECT

environmentVariables.description: Rename this server instance; defaults to the project name.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SERVER_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Replaces the default MCP instructions text sent to clients.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS

environmentVariables.description: Mount path for the MCP endpoint.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_HTTP_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Run the server process as this UID; the container entrypoint chowns writable paths to match.
environmentVariables.name: PUID

environmentVariables.description: Run the server process as this GID; pair with PUID to match the owner of a mounted volume.
environmentVariables.name: PGID

environmentVariables.description: Log level for FastMCP internals and app loggers (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL). The -v CLI flag overrides to DEBUG.
environmentVariables.name: FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Set false for plain or structured JSON log output.
environmentVariables.name: FASTMCP_ENABLE_RICH_LOGGING

environmentVariables.description: Ollama server URL for the ollama embedding provider. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the Ollama ecosystem convention.
environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_HOST

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key for the openai embedding provider, and the fallback key for the summarize tool when MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_API_KEY is unset. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the OpenAI ecosystem convention.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Bare fallback for MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_BASE_URL (embeddings). For the summarize tool it only routes traffic when an API key already enables the feature; it never enables summarize by itself.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Bare fallback for MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Maximum seconds an index-backed tool or resource waits for the FTS index to become queryable during a cold-start background build before raising IndexUnavailableError(reason="timeout"). Increase for large vaults.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BUILD_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: Maximum seconds an index-querying read tool waits for the IndexWriter to drain when called with wait_for_pending_writes=true. On timeout the tool answers from the current index and reports index_stale=true in the response _meta.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: Path to the markdown vault directory. Required — the server refuses to start without it. Symbolic links inside the vault are followed on Python 3.13+.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SOURCE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to hide the write tools (write, edit, append, delete, rename, move_folder, fetch, git_sync, the okf_* tools, create_upload_link) and serve a search-only vault. git_sync also needs managed git mode; create_upload_link needs an HTTP transport.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Hide the MCP Apps UI tools (browse_vault, show_context) from the tool listing for clients that do not render MCP Apps panels.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DISABLE_APPS_UI

environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite FTS5 index file; unset keeps the index in memory. Set it for persistence across restarts.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INDEX_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Path to the change-tracking state file. Defaults to {SOURCE_DIR}/.markdown_vault_mcp/state.json.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_STATE_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Path to the numpy embeddings file; required to enable semantic search.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDINGS_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields promoted to the tag index for structured filtering. Changing it cold-rebuilds the index once on next startup; SEARCHABLE_FIELDS inherits this value when unset.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INDEXED_FIELDS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields required on every document; documents missing any are excluded from the index.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_REQUIRED_FIELDS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated glob patterns excluded from scanning, e.g. .obsidian/**,.trash/**.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EXCLUDE

environmentVariables.description: Frontmatter field used as the document title (falls back to title, the first H1, then the filename). Changing it cold-rebuilds the index once on next startup.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TITLE_FIELD

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields whose text values become keyword-searchable and enrich first-chunk embeddings. Inherits INDEXED_FIELDS when unset; the sentinel none means filterable but not searchable. Changing it cold-rebuilds the index and re-embeds once on next startup.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SEARCHABLE_FIELDS

environmentVariables.description: Relative folder where note templates live (used by the create_from_template prompt).
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TEMPLATES_FOLDER

environmentVariables.description: Directory of .md prompt files that extend or override built-in prompts; a relative path is resolved against SOURCE_DIR.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_PROMPTS_FOLDER

environmentVariables.description: Filename of the per-folder conventions files surfaced to clients at write time (bare .md filename without glob characters). Set to none to disable folder conventions.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CONVENTIONS_FILE

environmentVariables.description: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) read semantics. With auto (the default), read annotations switch on when the vault declares an OKF version in its root index.md. Use off to disable OKF semantics entirely, or on to force them for an undeclared vault. Annotations are read-only; write behavior is never affected.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_MODE

environmentVariables.description: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) enforced write layer. When true on an OKF-active vault, the server stamps generated provenance on each write and clears any verified attestation when a note's content changes. It also keeps each written folder's log.md and index.md current, and exposes the okf_verify tool. Requires OKF_MODE to be auto or on (a true value with OKF_MODE=off is a config error). Off by default.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_WRITE

environmentVariables.description: How the okf_verify tool attributes a human review. This applies only when OKF_WRITE is on, which gates the tool. With elicit (the default), okf_verify asks the human to confirm the review through an MCP elicitation and records the attestation only on an affirmative reply. It fails closed when the client cannot elicit or the human declines, so a model that holds the human's token cannot self-attest. Use trust-auth to attribute to the authenticated caller with no confirmation (safe only when the sole caller is a human-driven UI), or off to hide the tool so attestation happens through external tooling. A non-default value with OKF_WRITE off is a config error.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_VERIFY

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed attachment extensions without the dot (e.g. pdf,png,jpg); use * to allow every non-markdown file. Unset selects the built-in allowlist.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS

environmentVariables.description: Maximum attachment size in MB returned by read / accepted by write; 0 disables the limit.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE_MB

environmentVariables.description: Maximum bytes returned by a full-document read of a note; use `read(path, section=…)` for partial reads. 0 disables the limit.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_NOTE_READ_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Maximum chunks returned per document in search results.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CHUNKS_PER_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Width of the snippet window (words) in search results; 0 returns full chunk content.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SNIPPET_WORDS

environmentVariables.description: Down-weights longer chunks in ranking: score / (1 + alpha * log(chunk_count)).
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_LENGTH_DOWNWEIGHT_ALPHA

environmentVariables.description: Word cap per chunk; the adaptive chunker splits at deeper heading levels, then paragraph/word boundaries, to respect it. Match it to the embedding model's context. A reindex applies a new value.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_CHUNK_WORDS

environmentVariables.description: Character cap enforced alongside MAX_CHUNK_WORDS to bound token-dense chunks. Unset derives min(1500, model context * 2.8). Set a positive value for an exact cap, or -1 to scale with the model's full context (can exhaust memory on long-context models). A reindex applies a new value.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_CHUNK_CHARS

environmentVariables.description: Words of overlap between adjacent budget-split fragments of the same heading section (0 disables). A reindex applies a new value.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CHUNK_OVERLAP_WORDS

environmentVariables.description: Folder-prefix score multipliers (`prefix:weight` pairs, comma-separated, weights > 0) applied to all search modes; the deepest matching prefix wins (sessions:0.5 demotes sessions/**).
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FOLDER_WEIGHTS

environmentVariables.description: Per-column BM25 weights (`column:weight` pairs, comma-separated, weights >= 0) for keyword ranking. Columns: path, title, folder, heading, content, summary.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FTS_WEIGHTS

environmentVariables.description: Embedding provider: openai, ollama, or fastembed. Unset auto-detects from the environment.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: Ollama embedding model name.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OLLAMA_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Force Ollama to embed on CPU only.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OLLAMA_CPU_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for embeddings; the bare OPENAI_BASE_URL is honoured as a fallback.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible embedding model name; the bare OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL is honoured as a fallback.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: FastEmbed model name.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FASTEMBED_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: FastEmbed model cache directory (in Docker, stored under /data/state/fastembed).
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FASTEMBED_CACHE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Enrich embedding input with the note title, chunk heading, and (first chunk) searchable-field values. Flipping it re-embeds the whole vault once on next startup.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBED_CONTEXT

environmentVariables.description: Per-request wall-clock budget in seconds for a single embedding HTTP call (OpenAI/Ollama). The local FastEmbed backend runs in-process with no network call and ignores this. CPU-only or large-model workloads may need 60-120 s; raise this if batches time out.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBED_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: Number of chunks sent per embedding request. Smaller batches shorten each request (useful under a tight timeout on slow models) at the cost of more round-trips.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE

environmentVariables.description: Token/password for HTTPS git auth; remotes must be HTTPS when set.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: HTTPS remote URL for managed git mode: the server clones into an empty SOURCE_DIR on startup (or validates an existing origin) and enables the pull loop, auto-commit, and deferred push.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_REPO_URL

environmentVariables.description: Username for HTTPS git auth prompts (x-access-token for GitHub, oauth2 for GitLab, the account name for Bitbucket).
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: Seconds between git fetch + fast-forward update attempts; 0 disables periodic pull.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_PULL_INTERVAL_S

environmentVariables.description: Seconds of write-idle time before pushing; 0 pushes only on shutdown.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_PUSH_DELAY_S

environmentVariables.description: Git committer name for auto-commits; set this in Docker where git config user.name is empty.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Git committer email for auto-commits.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: OIDC claim key used as the commit author name (e.g. name); overrides GIT_COMMIT_NAME per request when an OIDC token is present.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_NAME_CLAIM

environmentVariables.description: OIDC claim key used as the commit author email (e.g. email); overrides GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL per request when an OIDC token is present.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL_CLAIM

environmentVariables.description: Run git lfs pull on startup to fetch LFS-tracked attachments; set to false for repos without LFS.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_LFS

environmentVariables.description: Watch the vault for external filesystem changes; auto-disabled when git pull or the webhook is active. Requires the file-watcher extra.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER

environmentVariables.description: Seconds of quiet after the last filesystem event before reindexing.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER_DEBOUNCE_S

environmentVariables.description: Keep the non-recursive watch on the vault root; set false to register zero source-dir-rooted FSEvents streams (avoids repeated macOS access prompts on a home-rooted vault) at the cost of root-level files relying on scans.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER_ROOT_FLOOR

environmentVariables.description: Shared secret for the GitHub push-event webhook; when set, mounts POST /github-webhook on HTTP/SSE transports to trigger an immediate pull + reindex on push events.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Summarization backend (only openai is recognised). Unset auto-detects: the backend activates when credentials or an explicit endpoint are present.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible summarize endpoint; the bare OPENAI_API_KEY is honoured as a fallback. Unset works for keyless local endpoints (Ollama).
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint base URL for the summarize tool; setting it enables the tool even without an API key. The bare OPENAI_BASE_URL routes traffic only when a key already enables the feature.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Chat model id used for summaries.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Upper bound on generated tokens per summarize call; on reasoning models this budget also covers internal reasoning tokens.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_TOKENS

environmentVariables.description: Cap on the number of notes summarised in one call (subtree expansion truncates to this many).
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_NOTES

environmentVariables.description: Aggregate cap on note characters sent to the model in one call; excess is truncated with a flag on the result.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_INPUT_CHARS

environmentVariables.description: Per-request wall-clock budget in seconds for a single summarize backend call; keep it below the MCP client's request timeout so the server-side error wins the race.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: Link lifetime in seconds when the caller requests no explicit TTL.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_DEFAULT_S

environmentVariables.description: Ceiling in seconds a caller-requested link TTL is clamped to.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_MAX_S

environmentVariables.description: Post-success grace window in seconds: a served token's TTL shrinks to this so a stalled transfer can retry within it.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_GRACE_TTL_S

environmentVariables.description: Crashed-handler reclaim window in seconds for an in-flight reservation.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_LEASE_S

environmentVariables.description: Maximum size in bytes of a single upload.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Seconds a long-running tool call may run in the foreground before it is promoted to a background job and a job handle is returned instead.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_SOFT_DEADLINE_S

environmentVariables.description: Seconds a background-job record (working or finished) is retained for polling before it expires from the store.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_RESULT_TTL_S

environmentVariables.description: Maximum live background jobs per calling subject; further promotions are rejected until older records expire.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_MAX_PER_SUBJECT

title: Markdown Vault MCP
